introduction: This spec governs the extraction of the platform abstraction layer (`PlatformProtocol`, `GitHubPlatform`, label constants, and associated error types) from the `agentfox` monolith into a new standalone Python package named `afissues`, enabling lightweight consumers and future forge implementations to depend on it independently.

glossary.AfIssuesError: The base exception class for all errors raised by `afissues`; stores `**context` kwargs as a `.context` dict attribute.
glossary.AgentFoxError: The base exception class for `agentfox.core.errors`; independent of `AfIssuesError`.
glossary.ConfigError: An `AfIssuesError` subclass raised for configuration and validation errors such as SSRF guard violations.
glossary.GitHubPlatform: The GitHub forge implementation of `PlatformProtocol`, using `httpx.AsyncClient` for REST API calls.
glossary.IntegrationError: An `AfIssuesError` subclass raised for platform API/integration errors; carries a `retryable: bool` attribute defaulting to `True`.
glossary.IssueComment: A frozen dataclass representing a comment on an issue, with fields: `id`, `body`, `user`, `created_at`.
glossary.IssueResult: A frozen dataclass representing an issue fetched from a forge, with fields: `number`, `title`, `html_url`, `body`, `labels`.
glossary.LABEL_FIX: Label constant `str = "af:fix"` used to mark issues targeted for fixing.
glossary.LABEL_FIXED: Label constant `str = "af:fixed"` used to mark issues that have been resolved.
glossary.LABEL_IMPLEMENTED: Label constant `str = "af:implemented"` used to mark issues whose features are implemented.
glossary.LABEL_NO_CHANGE: Label constant `str = "af:no-change"` used to mark issues closed without a code change.
glossary.LabelSpec: A frozen dataclass with fields `name`, `color`, and `description` representing a forge label definition.
glossary.NullPlatform: A no-op stub implementation of `PlatformProtocol`; `create_pr()` intentionally raises `NotImplementedError`.
glossary.PlatformProtocol: A `typing.Protocol` class defining the async interface all forge implementations must satisfy (12 async methods + `close()`).
glossary.REQUIRED_LABELS: A `list[LabelSpec]` containing the four `af:*` labels that must exist on a GitHub repo.
glossary.SSRF guard: Server-Side Request Forgery protection logic embedded in `_SSRFGuardTransport` and `_validate_github_url` that prevents requests to internal/private network addresses.
glossary._SSRFGuardTransport: An `httpx.AsyncHTTPTransport` subclass that validates resolved IP addresses at the transport level to prevent SSRF attacks.
glossary._validate_github_url: A module-level function `(url: str) -> None` that raises `ConfigError` if the URL is not a permitted GitHub endpoint.
glossary.afaudit: An existing workspace package used as a structural reference for `afissues` package layout and build conventions.
glossary.afissues: The new standalone Python workspace package that houses the platform/forge abstraction layer extracted from `agentfox`.
glossary.afissues.errors: The `afissues/errors.py` module defining the independent `AfIssuesError`, `ConfigError`, and `IntegrationError` hierarchy.
glossary.afissues.github: The `afissues/github.py` module containing `GitHubPlatform` and associated SSRF guard helpers.
glossary.afissues.labels: The `afissues/labels.py` module containing `LabelSpec`, all `LABEL_*` constants, and `REQUIRED_LABELS`.
glossary.agentfox: The core agent-fox monolith Python package from which the platform layer is being extracted.
glossary.forge: A code hosting and issue-tracking platform such as GitHub, GitLab, or Gitea.
glossary.forge_type: A string attribute on platform implementations (e.g. `"github"`) used to identify the forge backend at runtime.
glossary.hatchling: The Python build backend used by workspace packages, declared in `[build-system]` of `pyproject.toml`.
glossary.httpx.AsyncClient: The primary async HTTP client class from `httpx` used by `GitHubPlatform`.
glossary.httpx.AsyncHTTPTransport: The base transport class from `httpx` that `_SSRFGuardTransport` extends.
glossary.httpx.Timeout: The `httpx` class for configuring per-phase connection timeouts.
glossary.make check: The monorepo top-level command that runs lint and all tests across all workspace packages.
glossary.nightshift: The `agentfox.nightshift` subpackage that contains the platform factory and orchestration logic.
glossary.parse_github_remote: A module-level function `(remote_url: str) -> tuple[str, str] | None` that extracts `(owner, repo)` from a GitHub remote URL.
glossary.platform_factory: The factory module at `agentfox.nightshift.platform_factory` that constructs platform instances; stays in `agentfox` with updated import paths.
glossary.py.typed: A PEP 561 marker file that signals to mypy/pyright that a package ships inline type annotations.
glossary.testpaths: The pytest ini option listing directories to discover tests in.
glossary.uv workspace: The monorepo package manager configuration that declares all `packages/*` members and resolves inter-package dependencies.
glossary.\"af:\": Label name prefix convention for agent-fox labels.
glossary.(owner, repo): The tuple returned by `parse_github_remote` containing the repository owner and name.
glossary.(remote_url: str) -> tuple[str, str] | N: Signature of `parse_github_remote`: accepts a remote URL string and returns an (owner, repo) tuple or None.
glossary.**context: Arbitrary keyword arguments stored as structured error context on exception instances.
glossary..hypothesis/: Hypothesis test framework's database directory; gitignored in this workspace.
glossary.4.2.0: Current version of the agent-fox workspace packages.
glossary.AfIssuesError(Exception): Declaration of `AfIssuesError` as a direct subclass of the built-in `Exception`.
glossary.ConfigError(AfIssuesError): Declaration of `ConfigError` as a subclass of `AfIssuesError`.
glossary.IntegrationError(AfIssuesError): Declaration of `IntegrationError` as a subclass of `AfIssuesError`.

user_story.goal: create a new `afissues` package with a valid `pyproject.toml` using `hatchling` and the correct metadata
user_story.benefit: the package can be installed independently and participates in the uv workspace without additional manual registration

acceptance_criteria.action: provides a `packages/afissues/pyproject.toml` declaring build-backend `hatchling`, package name `afissues`, version `4.2.0`, `requires-python = ">=3.12"`, and `dependencies = ["httpx>=0.27"]`
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: file exists and `pip install packages/afissues` succeeds without `agentfox` installed

acceptance_criteria.action: is automatically registered in the `uv workspace` because the root `pyproject.toml` uses `members = ["packages/*"]`; no manual entry is required
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: `uv sync` resolves `afissues` as a workspace member

acceptance_criteria.return_contract: `py.typed` file is present in the installed package's root directory
